metadata.author: quant-os
metadata.rationale: Mean-reversion contract: wide SL (2.5×ATR) gives price room to revert. Tight TP (0.7×ATR) captures quick snap-backs before mean reversion fades. Higher hit rate from small targets compensates wider SL. Designed for Brain_Rev assigned to OU/statarb strategies.
metadata.design_notes: Asymmetric label for mean-reversion models. TP=0.7×ATR targets the mean reversion sweet spot (half-life distance). SL=2.5×ATR prevents premature stop-out during reversion drawdown. Contract pairs with label-trend-1.0.0 in the dual-track training scheme.
